name: jea
description: Sistema de turmas e módulos com acesso por CPF

scripts.vendor: npm run vendor:blob && npm run vendor:pdf
scripts.vendor:pdf: echo "export { jsPDF } from 'jspdf'; export { autoTable } from 'jspdf-autotable';" | esbuild --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --minify --external:html2canvas --external:dompurify --external:canvg --outfile=public/vendor/pdf.js
